verdict.rationale: Poly offers programmatic access through a scriptable `poly` CLI with 25+ commands that can search, read, create, update and organize files. It also runs a live hosted MCP server that exposes search, fetch and a virtual `poly` CLI as tools over OAuth. There is no evidence of a public REST/OpenAPI surface (all OpenAPI probes returned 404), and nothing shows that UI features like sharing, Shared Drives, flashback/version recovery, journaling or imports are reachable programmatically. missing for 10: documented public API or OpenAPI spec, explicit UI/API parity statement, programmatic coverage of sharing/Shared Drives/version recovery/imports/Mind journaling, independent hands-on corroboration.
